messages:
max-people-ops: Quick update: were opening a Short-Form Evidence intake for the Q2 attestation cycle to reduce backlog for small infra-light teams. This is optional.

rita-eng: Whats the difference vs full intake?

max-people-ops: Short-Form = 6 items max + a 1-page manifest. Same controls, same acceptance criteria; faster triage.

maria-privacy: Clarification: Privacy/legal will still validate items. Short-Form is for intake efficiency only; more evidence may be requested.

tom-ops: Are training/attestation rules changing?

max-people-ops: No new training. Folks who finished security/privacy training within 7 months are eligible for a condensed attestation (4 questions). Attestation-bot will email eligible staff.

attestation-bot: Intake schema v2.2 required fields: team, primary_owner, manifest_link, repo_link, control_snapshot. Auto-lint runs on upload. Office hours Fri 15:00-16:00 PT (link posted in the portal). Deadline for first wave: 2170009000 (5 days).

rita-eng: Where to upload?

max-people-ops: Evidence Portal -> select "Short-Form Q2 2026". Name uploads like team-shortform-q2-2026.zip and include manifest.md at the root.

maria-privacy: Tag uploads SOC2-2026 and ISO27001-2026 and owner alias. Well prioritize reviews with clear manifests and links to CI runs.

rita-eng: Can we get a one-page checklist to pin to repos?

max-people-ops: Yes, well publish a checklist and manifest template in the Evidence Portal repo. PR expected today.

max-people-ops: TL;DR: Optional Short-Form Evidence intake to speed SOC2/ISO triage for small teams, same validation, portal + office hours + micro-attest eligibility. DM or join office hours for questions. :white_check_mark:
